hlg_0eed50333bcb0d01_001.rationale: The reconstructed high-level goal encompasses all distinct functional capabilities present in the low-level goals. llg_001 contributes the ability to add a specified quantity of a product from an offer to the shopping cart. llg_002 adds the capability to remove a specific product item from the shopping cart. llg_003 provides the functionality to change the quantity of a specific product already in the shopping cart. llg_004 includes the ability to retrieve and review all items, quantities, and total price in the shopping cart. llg_005 introduces the capability to proceed from the shopping cart to the order placement process. llg_006 adds the functionality to choose an available time slot for picking up an order. llg_007 contributes the ability to finalize and place an order after reviewing all details, including products, pickup slot, and payment method. llg_008 provides the capability to cancel a pending order before its pickup time. llg_009 includes the ability to retrieve a list of all past and pending orders. llg_010 adds the functionality to view the specific details of a particular order, including items, quantities, price, and status. hlg_f7a97fb976f1a448_001.reconstructed_high_level_goal: Enable Customers to manage their digital wallet by checking their current balance, depositing funds using specified payment methods, and reviewing all transaction records; to access order pickup information by viewing scheduled pickup times for pending orders and receiving notifications for upcoming pickups; and to interact with their fair-play score, which they can retrieve, and which the System automatically adjusts by decreasing it for no-shows, late pickups, and order cancellations, and increasing it for on-time order pickups.
